'''Microfine scrubbers''' were filters used in [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems. They were designed to detect and block unusual trace [[Gas/Legends|gases]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
